title: FrameAnalysis
description: Immutable per-frame snapshot handed to every analysis engine. All image coordinates are normalized 0..1, y down, in ANALYSIS space (upright, unmirrored). Engines may depend on nothing outside this structure.

timestampMs.description: Monotonic frame timestamp in milliseconds. The ONLY time source available to rules (no clock reads inside engines).

rotationDegrees.description: Rotation applied to the sensor buffer to obtain ANALYSIS space.

isMirrored.description: Sensor-level mirroring (front camera). ANALYSIS space is unmirrored; this flag only informs PREVIEW mapping and guidance direction semantics.

rollDegrees.description: Camera roll from the IMU, degrees, null when unavailable. Positive = clockwise in the device frame.

imuStability.description: 0..1, 1 = perfectly still; variance-based over a short window.

exposureValue.description: Camera-reported EV/AE hint if available; used to freeze/invalidate lighting statistics during AE transitions.

subjects.description: Ordered by prominence (visibleFraction * bbox area), most prominent first. MVP produces at most one.

light.description: LightReport; null when not computed this cycle.

scene.description: SceneReport (Phase 7+); always null in the MVP.

id.description: Anatomical landmark id, never spatial. BlazePose ids are used verbatim: nose, left_eye_inner, left_eye, left_eye_outer, right_eye_inner, right_eye, right_eye_outer, left_ear, right_ear, mouth_left, mouth_right, left_shoulder, right_shoulder, left_elbow, right_elbow, left_wrist, right_wrist, left_pinky, right_pinky, left_index, right_index, left_thumb, right_thumb, left_hip, right_hip, left_knee, right_knee, left_ankle, right_ankle, left_heel, right_heel, left_foot_index, right_foot_index

x.description: Normalized 0..1 in ANALYSIS space (may be outside [0,1] when the joint is out of frame but inferred).

z.description: Relative depth in the same scale as x/y (BlazePose z is NOT metric).

smoothed.description: true when a temporal filter has been applied to this landmark.

landmarks.description: 478 Face Landmarker points (id = index-based key such as face_0).

headPose.description: From the facial transformation matrix; null fields when unavailable.

blinkScore.description: 0..1, advisory only (blendshapes may be disabled in MVP).

trackId.description: Stable within a session; changes on identity re-association. NEVER derived from face identity.

worldLandmarks.description: Hip-origin world coordinates (metres-ish, z not metric).

motionEnergy.description: EMA of mean landmark velocity, normalized by torso length per second.

sources.description: Per-source freshness/latency metadata so engines can refuse stale data.

degradationLevel.description: Current step of the degradation ladder (performance-strategy.md §5).
